description: A friendly young British man, warm relaxed voice, natural and modern-sounding, slightly self-deprecating, smiling as he speaks.
text: Miss Frost. The set is forming, and I find I cannot bear to see it form without you. I should tell you I dance badly, though I have never yet let that stop me. Miss Lucas has asked me to ask you, and I could hardly refuse a lady, could I?
